dashboard.name: 42ab29d9-2088-46d8-a16c-dad72f16cac4
dashboard.displayName: Overlaid Detections vs Endpoints - Two Lines
dashboard.description: Two line series on one chart: daily rule detections (blue, in thousands) and distinct endpoints (orange). X = day (Australia/Sydney), Y = count, last 30 days. Endpoints excludes detections with no hostname.

dashboardCharts.name: 7786473f-1d28-47af-be60-6ed3526702e9
dashboardCharts.description: One line per Metric value: blue = detections per day in thousands (20.2 = 20,200), orange = distinct endpoints per day. Same Y axis.

dashboardQueries.name: 630ef31a-12f0-4860-bda6-8c73d6bbbe05
dashboardQueries.query:
detection.detection.rule_name != ""
$Day = timestamp.get_date(detection.detection_time.seconds, "Australia/Sydney")
$Endpoint = detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.hostname

match:
    $Day

outcome:
    $Detections = count_distinct(detection.id)
    // Detections without a hostname would count as one extra "endpoint"; subtract that bucket.
    $Endpoints = count_distinct($Endpoint) - max(if($Endpoint = "", 1, 0))

order:
    $Day desc

dashboardQueries.name: d69fab20-0b6e-4168-9c7e-f8d400ee945e
dashboardQueries.query:
// Daily totals from rule detections
stage daily {
    detection.detection.rule_name != ""
    $date = timestamp.get_date(detection.detection_time.seconds, "Australia/Sydney")
    $key = strings.concat(strings.substr(detection.id, 0, 0), "k")
    $endpoint = detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.hostname
    match:
        $date, $key
    outcome:
        $detections = count_distinct(detection.id)
        // Detections without a hostname would count as one extra "endpoint"; subtract that bucket.
        $endpoints = count_distinct($endpoint) - max(if($endpoint = "", 1, 0))
        // Same values as floats so both metrics share one Count column; detections in thousands.
        $detections_k = math.round(count_distinct(detection.id) / 1000, 1)
        $endpoints_f = (count_distinct($endpoint) - max(if($endpoint = "", 1, 0))) / 1
}

// Exactly two rows, labelled "Detections (thousands)" and "Endpoints". The label comes from the detection hour
// only to produce two rows; the counts in this stage are never used.
stage metrics {
    detection.detection.rule_name != ""
    $metric = if(timestamp.get_hour(detection.detection_time.seconds) < 12, "Detections (thousands)", "Endpoints")
    $key = strings.concat(strings.substr(detection.id, 0, 0), "k")
    match:
        $metric, $key
    outcome:
        $unused = count_distinct(detection.id)
}

// Join every day to both metric rows -> Day / Metric / Count
$key = $daily.key
$key = $metrics.key
$Day = $daily.date
$Metric = $metrics.metric

match:
    $Day, $Metric

outcome:
    $Count = max(if($Metric = "Detections (thousands)", $daily.detections_k, $daily.endpoints_f))

order:
    $Day asc
